value.rationale: The motivated inverse problem asks not merely how many Parikh signatures occur but how many distinct morphic factors share each signature. The result determines all fiber cardinalities at every substitution length, including the nontrivial central-overlap anomaly, and shows a dense pure-point weak limit with exact 1/20 variance. This is a structural limit law for a canonical morphic word, not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere restatement of its known factor-complexity total.
